title: Körner Hellweg, Dortmund
description:
This 5-room WG offers a comfortable and well-equipped living space in a convenient location.

Apartment Features:
Fully Furnished Rooms: Each room includes a bed, desk, wardrobe, shelves, and table lamp.
Fully Equipped Kitchen: Features a refrigerator, oven, stove, electric kettle, dishwasher, toaster, crockery, and cutlery.
Washing machine and Wi-Fi are available.

Location:
Excellent Public Transport Access: Well-connected by S-Bahn, U-Bahn, and bus lines for easy travel around the city.
Nearby Amenities: Several supermarkets, shops, pharmacies, and restaurants are within walking distance.
Convenient Living: Located in Körne, a well-connected and residential area, providing both a quiet environment and easy access to the city center.
It takes between 30 to 60 minutes to reach TU Dortmund University by public transport from the apartment. 

Additional Information:

Tenants are responsible for maintaining cleanliness during their stay.
A one-time membership fee of €70 applies.
Upon move-out, tenants must pay a mandatory bed linen fee of €30 and a cleaning fee of €130.

title: Brackeler Hellweg, Dortmund
description:
This 30 m2 apartment is ideally situated near Brackel Kirche, with S-Bahn and U-Bahn stops just a short walk (hidden) takes take around 40 minutes to reach TU Dortmund University by public transport from the apartment.  Supermarkets and various shopping facilities are also within easy reach.

Apartment Features:
Living Space: Includes a living room with a joint kitchen.
Furnished for Comfort: Features a double bed, pull-out sofa bed (sleeps 2), table, TV, and bookshelves.
Fully Equipped Kitchen: Comes with a microwave, hob, fridge, toaster, kettle, coffee maker, crockery, and cutlery.
Bathroom: Includes a toilet and shower.


Additional Information:

Tenants are responsible for maintaining cleanliness during their stay.
A one-time membership fee of €140 applies.
Upon move-out, tenants must pay a mandatory bed linen fee of €30 and a cleaning fee of €130.

title: Brackeler Hellweg, Dortmund
description: Entspanntes Wohnen im Grünen: Dieses ruhige Studio-Apartment mit Blick auf den Garten verspricht Erholung pur. Genieße den eigenen Balkon, Parkplatz & eine vollausgestattete Küche. Mit dem modernen TV endet dein Tag gemütlich. Die Straßenbahn direkt vor der Tür bringt dich in 15 Min. in die Stadtmitte oder zum Hauptbahnhof. Der Flughafen ist ebenfalls nur 15 Autominuten entfernt – ideal für Studenten und Business-Reisende, die eine ruhige Oase mit schneller Anbindung suchen.
